title: RecurrentGemma 9B Release
summary: Google released the RecurrentGemma 9B variant on June 11, 2024. Google's official model card describes RecurrentGemma as a family of open English-language models built on a recurrent architecture developed at Google, with both pre-trained and instruction-tuned versions.
significance: A dated 9B-parameter expansion of Google's RecurrentGemma open language-model family.
